scope: Notification Slice5 audience projection author recon
sourceState: Slice5 v6 source anchors remain individually hash-bound; v8 adds exact supported-baseline source policy adoption plus the two allowed PostgreSQL finalizer creator catalogs and runtime fingerprint.

facts.projectionIsolation: READ COMMITTED with one MATERIALIZED authority-bundle statement and a fixed finalizer that locks runtime, organization, then outbox through COMMIT
facts.slice5ProjectedSettlementRole: notification_projection_finalizer fixed function, executable only by app_notification_worker
projectionScopeModes: revalidation: exact ready candidate receipt; no historical scheduler lease
facts.sourceRlsCombination: no PUBLIC source policy; exact legacy policies retargeted to current command-capable roles plus relation owner, plus one complete permissive app_notification_worker SELECT policy per relation
facts.sameGenerationRenewalSemantics: runtime heartbeat and organization/event renewal preserve scoped identity; the finalizer reads the refreshed deadline and may proceed, while release/replacement/reclaim invalidates scope
facts.terminalOperationIdentity: notification_outbox terminal_owner_id + terminal_generation, trigger-captured from the old live lease; historical null/null is unattributed
facts.projectionReceiptFinalization: receipt inserted with finalized_at null; fixed finalizer alone sets it after candidate-set verification in the same terminal transaction
facts.terminalObserverProof: exact terminal outbox attribution plus immutable finalized receipt; later candidate cancellation/cascade cannot invalidate committed evidence
facts.projectionCommitGuard: one deferred receipt INSERT trigger; trigger-only definer derives exact scope from immutable NEW identity, reselects current finalized receipt and attributed terminal outbox, and never reads candidates
facts.projectionCommitGuardRls: finalizer-role projection_commit_guard SELECT branches only; no application role or caller GUC can activate them
facts.projectionCommitGuardNewUsage: immutable row identity only; NEW.finalized_at is ignored and current finalized_at is reselected
facts.sourcePolicyRecursiveResult: 42P17 infinite recursion detected in policy for relation organization_members
facts.sourcePolicyAdoption: retarget ten inventoried PUBLIC policies to exact command-capable roles plus the exact relation owner; retain two existing app_ledger policies; add one complete app_notification_worker SELECT policy per source relation
facts.sourcePolicyRuntimeAdmission: exact post-v8 ACL, owner, membership and policy catalog before acquiring the worker runtime lease

finalizerCreatorModes.supabasePostgres17: exact member postgres, target notification_projection_finalizer, grantor supabase_admin, admin=true, inherit=false, set=false, usage=false

facts.finalizerRuntimeAdmission: exact captured creator mode plus ordered source ACL/policy/owner, role attributes/membership closure, three definer functions and commit-guard trigger; every field compared before runtime lease
facts.finalizerForbiddenEdges: any worker/ordinary role ADMIN edge; any non-platform member/grantor; any INHERIT/SET/USAGE reachability

sourceAnchors.detail: Revision is 2026-10-03.1; entry() fixes schemaVersion 1 and integrated false; lines 98-132 define the three join policies.
users.manage is exact-target users:manage; subject.or_users_manage is applicant/subject OR target-org manager.
Events store kind/schema/catalog; outbox lines 71-95 store only catalog revision and index claims by revision.
Projector advertises only supportedCatalogRevisions and owns one projectPage callback.
Production projector remains null; current check only asks whether the projector supports the current catalog revision.
Discovery accepts 1..8 revisions and eligibility probes exact organization/state/revision, not kind/schema.
Claim and unsupported probes are catalog-revision based and can return up to 250 events.
The durable loop passes revision support to discovery and invokes one owned projector callback per organization lease.
Existing worker transactions set notification_worker, exact org/owner GUCs, 3s statement and 250ms lock timeouts.
Current fresh resolver caps raw members at 1000, requires active exact-org membership, evaluates roles/rules, and also reads auth.users email state.
defaultCaps, explicit-role replacement, overrides, owner scope and field level are code-owned authority semantics.
Current insert writes both canonical user_id and supabase_id; own pending reads are applicant-scoped and bounded.
Create commits before best-effort email; approve/deny use separate Supabase operations and are not appendNotificationEvent producers.
join_request has UUID id/supabase_id, text user_id/organization_id, status, created/reviewed timestamps and applicant PII columns; this anchor is distinct from the exact RLS-policy inventory below.
/users/join-requests is gated by org-capability users:manage.
The authenticated applicant waiting route reads only own pending requests and redirects a now-member home.
notification_scheduler_fence is a volatile EXISTS predicate; runtime/org rows and coordinator transition guards exist, but no projection finalizer serializes runtime -> organization -> outbox.
Current notification_worker settlement accepts projected directly, verifies only live event owner/generation, and provides no post-terminal receipt/outbox observation entrypoint.
RuntimeIdentity plus generation/expiry form RuntimeLease; OrganizationLease is separate; the current projector callback receives neither RuntimeLease nor its generation.

Coordinator transitions lock runtime before organization. Same-generation organization renewal changes only renewal_count and lease_expires_at; release clears authority and reclaim increments generation.

Supported baseline begins ten relevant policies as PUBLIC. The exact organization_members admin branch reads profiles while the required worker profiles branch reads organization_members; the executable child-database reproduction proves the combined graph raises PostgreSQL 42P17.

Runtime heartbeat preserves owner, generation and build/catalog/projector identity while refreshing last_heartbeat_at and lease_expires_at; release clears owner/expiry and acquisition increments generation.
organization_members_admin_all reads profiles and organization_members_self_select uses auth.uid; both are PUBLIC in the supported baseline.
profiles self SELECT and UPDATE are PUBLIC; exact command-specific grantees differ because app_ledger has SELECT only.

Exact grants show anon, authenticated and service_role on all six source relations; app_ledger has only the listed organization-member/profile/member-role/permission-rule commands, while app_assistant_ro and brain_vector_worker have none.

gaps.summary: Revision-only support would let a partial projector claim unsupported kinds in the same catalog revision.
gaps.requiredDecision: Route, discover, claim and report support by exact catalog revision/kind/schema tuple plus adapter revision.

gaps.summary: No per-recipient candidate table, projection receipt, projection role, atomic cap or cancellation state exists.
gaps.requiredDecision: Add forced-RLS receipt/candidate storage and a distinct least-privilege projection role.

gaps.summary: The existing fresh email resolver has the wrong 1000 raw-member cap and destination surface for a 10000-recipient in-app audience.
gaps.requiredDecision: Create transaction-bound role-first in-app authority resolution with shared RBAC semantics and no auth.users read.

gaps.summary: Join applicant entitlement can be forged if payload, request, organization and both historical identity columns are not bound together.
gaps.requiredDecision: Require exact request/org/profile/status/revision agreement and one no-leak invalid-subject outcome.

gaps.summary: A candidate created before revocation can become stale before a later read/effect.
gaps.requiredDecision: Store authority digest and require current revalidation with irreversible cancellation before future publication.

gaps.summary: Current join flows are not transaction-outbox producers, so marking them integrated in Slice5 would invent durable source evidence.
gaps.requiredDecision: Keep integrated false and qualify adapters with controlled real event appends; producer wiring remains a later slice.

gaps.summary: A template key alone does not freeze localized candidate bytes or enforce the per-recipient body limit across later builds.
gaps.requiredDecision: Bind immutable versioned template bytes and digests into the projector manifest and every candidate; changed copy requires a new adapter revision.

gaps.summary: Separate READ COMMITTED source reads could mix membership, request, role and rule states, while REPEATABLE READ would hide a later operational lease replacement.
gaps.requiredDecision: Keep READ COMMITTED; use one bounded MATERIALIZED authority-bundle statement, then serialize final publication under runtime -> organization -> outbox locks through COMMIT without automatic replay.

gaps.summary: Current projector input and application grants cannot prove the exact live runtime, organization and event generations at claim and final projection.
gaps.requiredDecision: Carry RuntimeLease plus OrganizationLease and event receipt; enforce exact DB fences and derive source subject from the exact event instead of a free subject GUC.

gaps.summary: notification_worker can currently mark a live claim projected without any durable projection receipt or candidate-set proof.
gaps.requiredDecision: Revoke claim-role projection and direct application-role terminal updates; a fixed finalizer recomputes exact receipt count, bytes and sorted digest. Quarantine requires an empty set.

gaps.summary: The draft processing query order omitted lease expiry even though its partial index orders tuple, expiry, event.
gaps.requiredDecision: Use pending tuple/event and expired-processing tuple/expiry/event query classes with exact EXPLAIN and removal gates.

gaps.summary: Recipient cap alone does not bound role/rule fanout, assignment rows, equivalence groups or authority evidence bytes.
gaps.requiredDecision: Enforce exact pre-insert role/rule/assignment/group/byte caps and quarantine atomically on overflow.

gaps.summary: Revalidation lacked exact time/query limits and conflated profile erasure with a retained cancelled candidate.
gaps.requiredDecision: Use one bounded RC authority statement plus fresh CAS; unavailable never cancels, profile deletion cascades the row and leaves the receipt, digest drift uses authority_changed.

gaps.summary: A fresh READ COMMITTED fence without row locks can observe the old runtime/organization tuple and still publish after a concurrent replacement commits.
gaps.requiredDecision: Use a narrow fixed finalizer owned by an inaccessible role; lock runtime, organization and outbox in canonical order, recheck all identities/deadlines after acquisition, update inside the function and hold locks through immediate COMMIT.

gaps.summary: The supported baseline PUBLIC policy graph becomes recursively self-referential for the projection role; a restrictive worker policy cannot make the v6 adoption executable.
gaps.requiredDecision: Retarget only the exact inventoried PUBLIC policies to every command-capable browser/service/application role plus the exact relation owner, add one complete nonrecursive worker policy per source relation, and prove pre/post consumer parity plus runtime catalog admission.

gaps.summary: After projected commit the live processing scope disappears, so an ambiguous commit response cannot be classified by either current worker role and must not rerun projection.
gaps.requiredDecision: Persist exact claim owner/generation in the receipt and add one bounded fixed terminal observer with finite committed/processing/superseded/quarantined/pending/absent/integrity/unavailable no-replay outcomes.

gaps.summary: The prior wording incorrectly said a normal same-generation heartbeat or renewal invalidates the finalizer even though Slice4 renewals preserve all scoped identity fields and only extend deadlines.
gaps.requiredDecision: Observe a winning valid renewal and proceed only with sufficient refreshed deadline; only retirement/release/replacement/reclaim/identity change or expiry invalidates scope.

gaps.summary: Recomputing the current candidate set during ambiguous-commit observation would reject a valid committed projection after the supported profile cascade or candidate cancellation changes that set.
gaps.requiredDecision: Finalizer-attest the immutable receipt after set verification; observe exact projected terminal identity plus that finalized receipt without rereading mutable candidate rows.

gaps.summary: A terminal quarantine clears lease_owner, so generation alone cannot attribute it to the observing operation and a newer quarantine or wrong owner could be mistaken for this operation.
gaps.requiredDecision: Trigger-capture terminal owner and generation on every new terminal transition; classify historical null attribution separately and require both values for exact committed/quarantined outcomes.

gaps.summary: After the SECURITY DEFINER finalizer returns, a deferred trigger runs from the application transaction while terminal-row RLS hides the finalized receipt/outbox; the inserted NEW row also still carries finalized_at null, so the prior two-function model could not enforce its claimed commit guard.
gaps.requiredDecision: Add one fixed trigger-only definer and one deferred receipt INSERT constraint trigger; derive exact guard scope internally from immutable trigger identity, reselect current finalized evidence through narrow terminal RLS, reject direct execution, and use no per-candidate trigger.

changes: executable baseline reproduction proves the v6 keep-PUBLIC plus restrictive-worker design raises PostgreSQL 42P17
ten PUBLIC policies are retargeted without expression or command changes to exact current ACL consumers and exact relation owners
existing app_ledger-only policies remain role-specific and app_assistant_ro/brain_vector_worker retain no source privilege
one complete nonrecursive app_notification_worker SELECT policy per source relation replaces permissive-plus-restrictive pairs
migration and runtime admission bind exact ACL, owner, role membership and policy catalogs
plain PostgreSQL 18 permits no finalizer membership edge while Supabase PostgreSQL 17 permits only the exact platform-creator ADMIN-only edge with no SET, INHERIT or USAGE
command-role enumeration derives every direct table and column ACL grantee plus the exact relation owner instead of hiding unknown grantees behind a fixed role list
native parity covers browser self/admin, service, app-ledger GUC/JWT, owner/migration and denied roles before and after adoption
